steps.content: [Altar Lower Half - Damaged]
The immense form stands at the chamber's heart, quivering almost imperceptibly. The copper coins tremble in response, countless as eyes that blink and stare.
A voice, soft and unhurried, floats through the air, fading to a whisper by the time it finds you.

steps.speaker: Shifu?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>You've come...

steps.speaker: Shifu?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>You...
It suddenly thrashes as if grappling with an invisible force, its limbs twisting and seizing midair, barely able to hold its human semblance.
Beneath you, the black sludge swells and bubbles. Those limbs rise sluggishly from the depths, their fingers locking around your ankles, dragging you back.
With each step forward, those fingers burrow into your flesh, peeling away strips of skin. Viscous fluid rushes into the wounds. So this is what she suffered, like being scorched from the inside.
You clench your jaw.
[Red Flash]

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: But I saw something else, too. No matter how many times those disasters descend upon us, there's nothing to be afraid of.
[Red Flash]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nngh!

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Because people have faced them again and again—and defeated them, again and again.
[Red Flash]
<i>Faster... you must... keep going forward...

steps.speaker: Shifu?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Persist in your folly...

steps.speaker: Shifu?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i><b>...and the price will be steep...!
A tide of black, viscous tentacles erupts from beneath its robes, reeking of decay. They lash against your arms and legs and wind tight around you.
A blade flashes before your eyes. The dark hands grasping you are severed in a single sweep, black mist bleeding from the stumps.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Wrong target.
Chengxiao moves before you, his body a shield. He raises his sword, the blade still stained with blood from the ritual, now running in slow rivulets down the steel.
The golden light reaches the Apostle and instantly becomes rope, winding around it in tightening coils.
The monster convulses. Something rips through it from the inside, and white light erupts as a gaping hollow tears open in its body, black mist roiling at the torn edges.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Go now.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: There are people waiting for us.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Right.
A howling gale blasts outward from the hollow. You push into the light and rush headlong toward the Apostle's core.
[Rumble + White Flash]
Chengxiao stands alone before the thing wearing his shifu's voice and face.

steps.speaker: Shifu?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Why... do you point your blade at me...

steps.speaker: Shifu?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Do you still mean to... defy the will of Heaven...?

steps.speaker: Shifu?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>...You were always the most sensible one... the one who knew his place...
No answer came. Her footsteps gradually faded into the distance.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Anyway, I've saved you a ticket and a spot on the expedition. Whether you show up or not, that's on you.
He turned the copper coin between his fingers, its surface burnished by years of handling.
She almost reached the front door, then hesitated mid-step, turned on her heel, and made her way toward the back.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Taking the back trail down, are we?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Beats those front stairs. You keep them so polished they might as well be waxed. I almost took a tumble on my way up.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Besides, turns out there's actually a new trail through the back hills now.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: We have taken in more children of late. I imagine they've worn it into the hill with all their running about. No one can keep them in hand. Each one harder to catch than the last.
Li Xianling burst out laughing and pushed the door open. Sunlight flooded through the gap, throwing her silhouette across the floorboards.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: We will meet again there.
Behind him came the rustle of fabric. He imagined Li Xianling giving him a casual wave—her version of a goodbye.

Her footsteps trailed off toward the back hill. When they were young, the adults had forbidden the children from taking that shortcut, insisting it was too dangerous, prowling with wolves and bandits. Li Xianling, of course, had never listened and had spent years goading him into breaking the rule with her.
In hindsight, it makes no difference. Front hill or back, both paths eventually led down to the clamor of the town streets.
Just like this moment right now.
Chengxiao runs his fingers slowly along the flat of the blade. His own face stares back from the steel, and for a fleeting second, it looks almost unfamiliar.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: What is taken must be repaid, and what is sought comes at a cost. Without rules, nothing holds its shape. Everything the sect taught me, I remember every word.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: But if that is so, then those who keep to the path are owed a good end, and those who stray will reap what they have sown. Every fate is already settled in your eyes.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: If the best outcome is always assured, no matter what, then why send those voices to guide us along the way at all?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: ...Perhaps because even you cannot control it. The ending may be fixed, but what we learn along the road, and how we choose to walk it... those remain beyond your reach.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: And that matters to you, doesn't it?

steps.speaker: Shifu?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>The human... heart...

steps.speaker: Shifu?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>The human heart... is fickle above all... never to be...

steps.speaker: Shifu?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>...trusted...
[Screen shake + flash]
The void inside the Apostle's form gapes ever wider. Its voice fractures into broken shards, until at last it can no longer weave those gentle, tempting words.

steps.speaker: Discordant Whispers
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i><b>Foolish... arrogant... self-righteous mortals...

steps.speaker: Discordant Whispers
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i><b>Destined... destined for ruin...!

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Heh. Indeed...
[24 Transition to white screen + Lichen's corrupted, no-mask dark silhouette]
Her blurred silhouette stands at the center of the creature, hemmed in by twisting, thrashing limbs that still carry the faint suggestion of human forms.
Draped across her is the heart of everything: a shapeless monster that drains the sorrow and desperate prayers of humanity to keep itself from unraveling.
At your presence, the limbs rage anew. Screams pour into your ears, and the black mist rises to blind you.
[Empty scene 2s + black corruption]
[White flash + bell SFX, then transition into awakening CG]
Her bound hands can no longer raise the bell high, but the chime continues. Every time the black mist swells and threatens to bury the road ahead of you, the bell scatters it. Again and again.
And through the clearing haze, you can see it plainly now: how those limbs pierce straight through her chest, clawing frantically for something, hope, perhaps, or the price for it.
Yet from a human body, only flesh and blood can ever be taken. And what use is any of that, if the person simply refuses to fall?
You move toward her step by step, just as she once advanced here step by step. Stubborn and unyielding. Never stopping.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: ...Such is the human heart. You can calculate every outcome down to the last detail, and still they will hope, at the final moment, for fate to bend just a little. Even if what comes next is more than they can bear.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: You have fed on their offerings, their prayers, their fears, their hopes. You, who have nourished yourself on the hearts of mankind, must now bear the price of them.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Those are the rules you yourself set down.
He lifts his sword and levels it at the creature once more. Black tentacles whip around the blade and drag him forward with savage strength.
His sword arm holds fast, unmoving. The only sound is the crack of bones giving way.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: When all is said and done... I am only human...
He wrenches the blade around with a violent twist and slashes straight for the monster's face.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Obstinate to the end. You have brought this on yourself.
[White Flash + Sword Strike SFX]
[24 Transition to Chief Mini CG]
The shackles inside you shiver with a subtle hum. At your back, a blade catches the light; through your chest, the bell's chime resounds. And in that instant, a lightness floods through you.
So you break into a run.

steps.speaker: Shifu
steps.content: Li Xianling. Trespassing on the sect's forbidden grounds not once, not twice, but repeatedly. And speaking irreverently of the immortals. And Lyu Buzhou, you knew of this, said nothing, and even mapped out her route for her...

steps.speaker: Shifu
steps.content: Every complaint the sect has about the two of you all lands on my desk...

steps.speaker: Li Xianling
steps.content: Oh, come on, Shifu! Think about it. If I actually found the immortal, that'd be a huge win for the sect, right? Total honor and glory. Shouldn't that cancel out a few little rule bends? Rules were made for people, not the other way around!

steps.speaker: Lyu Buzhou
steps.content: Shifu, the classical texts do state that rules ought to adapt to the shifting demands of the times and the needs of the people.

steps.speaker: Lyu Buzhou
steps.content: ...After all, immortals, humans, and beasts are fundamentally different by nature. Surely it stands to reason that one cannot measure them all by the same yardstick.

steps.speaker: Li Xianling
steps.content: Wait, Lyu Buzhou! You think I didn't catch that? You better believe when I finally meet an immortal, I am not telling you a single thing about what they look like!

steps.speaker: Shifu
steps.content: Enough, enough, both of you! ...Fine. I will go and make your apologies myself.

steps.speaker: Shifu
steps.content: Truly, I never needed either of you to bring glory to this sect.

steps.speaker: Shifu
steps.content: If the world could settle into something a little more peaceful, and you two could remain just as you are right now... that would be more than enough for me.
Perhaps, to some greater being, humanity is nothing but frantic ants, blind to all but the road ahead, never realizing that their every step leads only to ruin.
Yet what makes them human is this: when a crossroads rises before them, they choose the manner of their own destruction.
With prudence or obstinance.
With hubris or valor.
With faith or doubt.

steps.speaker: Ziwei App
steps.content: Transmitting data... Warning. Warning: large-scale emotional fluctuation detected among users. Warning. Warning—

<i>　　　I do believe...　　　　　 <size=38>I want to believe...</size>　　　　<size=50> Please, heavenly immortals, bless us...</size>
　　　<i><size=52>No... I can't believe it...</color></size> <size=50>This is... Clearly, this is...</size>
　　　　　　　　<i>But even in this form... <size=38>you must still be merciful,</size> <size=52>right...?</color></size>

　　　　　　<size=38><i>If the immortals are indeed real...</size> then why have they never listened...? 　　　Please, bless us...
<size=52><i>Then why do they make us suffer...?!</size>
　　　 　　　<i><size=52>I can only... I can only believe...</color></size>
<i><b><size=50>I can only believe in myself now...!
The black mist shrieks and scatters. The shapeless mass crumbles again, writhing desperately as it tries to pull itself together.
Nothing blocks your path now, not ahead, not behind.
<i>Is now the time to say sorry?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In a hundred years, the calamities, the Mania... we haven't beaten any of it. Just failure after failure. Losing people, over and over. You, and them...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But... I still want you to see.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Then let me borrow your eyes a moment. Let me see that even fate itself can't bring the mortal world to ruin.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's all because you were here. I'll remember that you were here.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Fate has laid its course plain before us... I ask only that it hesitates, if only for a moment, on my account.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even if that's the only reason I'm standing here right now.
There is only one thing left to do.

You look into her eyes, truly look into them for the first time. Not at a lying Daoist who spoke nothing but deceit, not at a pitiful madwoman poisoned by the abyss, not at a lost soul wandering and waiting to be rescued.
You look at Li Xianling and reach out your hand.
[Hand-Holding CG]
She seizes your wrist and clings to it, dragging it toward her chest with all her remaining strength. The ribbons wound around her arms cut deeper into the flesh that still marks her as human.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Fear not.
Then, between your pulse and hers, thorns of bright crimson blossom into being.
[Full CG Awakening - Split]
The shackles drive through her chest, splintering her earrings and blasting apart the dark mist massed at her back.
She hears her heart tear open once more, cleft in two, pulsing against the shackles.
But nothing could be better than this. Because this body will never be hollow.
